specs.title: @os-2254 @ruleR0 @negative R0-01 GSTIN mismatch → rejection reason says GST_MISMATCH (not generic)
@os-2254 @ruleC @negative RC-01 income<15000, no turnover → Rule C REJECT
@os-2254 @ruleC @edge RC-02 income<15000 but turnover slab lifts it → no Rule C reject
@os-2254 @ruleC @edge RC-03 income exactly 15000 → boundary, no Rule C reject
@os-2254 @ruleC @positive RC-04 income 50000 → Rule C never applies
@os-2254 @ruleC @edge RC-05 income<15000 + top slab 'Rs.500 Cr. and above' (capped at 500 Cr) → derived ~4.16 Cr/mo ≥ 15000 → NO Rule C reject
@os-2254 @ruleC @negative RC-06 income 0 (lowest) + no turnover → both 0 < 15000 → Rule C REJECT
@os-2254 @ruleC @edge RC-07 income 15001 (just above boundary) + no turnover → NO Rule C reject
@os-2254 @ruleC @edge RC-08 income<15000 + mid slab 'Rs.1.5 Cr. to 5 Cr.' → derived 4,16,667 ≥ 15000 → NO Rule C reject
@os-2254 @pcsm @positive PCSM-01 all 7 GST PCSM slots populated with correct values [matched]
@os-2254 @pcsm @edge PCSM-03 same 7 slots also present in downstream OMNI_PRE/HC/POST
@os-2254 @str02 @positive STR02-01 match → Karza businessType overrides the customer's value
@os-2254 @str02 @edge STR02-02 no GSTIN/no match → customer's value kept as-is
@os-2254 @str02 @edge STR02-03 Karza fails → customer's value kept as-is [stub]
